Two women found dead in UP police stations; investigations underway

Two separate incidents involving women have been reported at police stations in Uttar Pradesh. In Bahraich, a 28-year-old female constable was found dead by hanging in a police station's staff room. In Bijnor, a rape survivor who set herself on fire at a police station has died during treatment. Investigations are ongoing in both cases, with no suicide note found in the Bahraich incident and police searching for an accused soldier in the Bijnor case.
